title: Mollie payments
readyTest: Test mode: no real money is used.
problem_no_key: Add your Mollie access code in the settings to start.
problem_bad_key: The access code does not look right. It starts with test_ or live_.
problem_site_private: Real payments need a public secure address (https) for your site.
step2: Paste your Mollie access code in the settings.
siteOk: Your site has a public secure address.
sitePrivate: Your site is not public yet. Mollie cannot tell it about payments, so the shop checks them itself.
testOnlyTestKey: A test payment needs a test access code.
testFailed: The test payment could not be created. Check your access code.
testCreated: Test payment created. Open it below.
